finals.text: {"type":"selection","packet_sha256":"13592fd737765372f061b830cee068c45296190026350449c7cec6eff55f8dc7","choices":[{"id":"ab66de7edad40236ffd5","reason":"At 10/1, predicted V1/V2 are 18.5/26.7 mL. Paired with the 20/1 choice, this tests the steep predicted solvent-ratio response of diethyl malonate; same-molecule observed evidence is absent.","hypothesis_id":"H1"},{"id":"d7b0845793265cab0c33","reason":"At 20/1, predicted V1/V2 rise to 30.7/49.3 mL with the same loading conditions as the 10/1 choice. This tests a large, currently unmeasured change before the pending 50/1 experiment.","hypothesis_id":"H1"},{"id":"33123966b214578291a5","reason":"The 5/1 fluorobenzoate prediction is 5.9/16.8 mL. Its measured 2/1 and 50/1 endpoints bracket this setting, while the paired 10/1 prediction has a slightly lower V2; measuring both tests that possible curve-shape blind spot.","hypothesis_id":"H2"},{"id":"09f7ce5c473ea7ea5d94","reason":"At the same 100 µL loading as the 5/1 choice, predicted V2 falls from 16.8 to 16.0 mL at 10/1. The local reversal is an untested model inference despite the broader measured increase from 2/1 to 50/1.","hypothesis_id":"H2"},{"id":"bbb514661c0a49694d6a","reason":"The 20/1 benzoylformate prediction is 9.8/28.7 mL. Same-molecule measurements at 5/1 and 10/1 show similar V2 values, so this probes whether that apparent plateau extends to a weaker eluent.","hypothesis_id":"H3"},{"id":"7b42519983cf93dd7efd","reason":"At 50/1, predicted V1/V2 remain near 11.1/29.0 mL. Paired with 20/1, this tests the model's high-ratio plateau for both endpoints; the measured support currently reaches only 10/1.","hypothesis_id":"H3"},{"id":"693a65467095367c8e95","reason":"The 10/1 anthranilate prediction is 13.6/25.7 mL versus measured values near 9/17 mL at 5/1. It tests the first step of a predicted rise in this hydrogen-bonding molecule; evidence for the rise is weak.","hypothesis_id":"H4"},{"id":"74541dbf8571f881c454","reason":"At the same 100 µL loading, the 20/1 prediction rises to 21.2/43.0 mL. This checks whether the model's large solvent-ratio response is real before the pending 50/1 result is revealed.","hypothesis_id":"H4"},{"id":"5ae7472a4d9ce3fe20d0","reason":"For cyanobenzophenone, the only found measurement is 3.6/8.9 mL at 0/1. The 5/1 prediction of 12.1/33.7 mL bridges that observation and the pending 10/1–20/1 experiments, testing a possible extrapolation blind spot.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"63962b52800b6ead5398","reason":"The 0/1 nitroacetophenone prediction of 4.8/8.6 mL provides a strong-eluent anchor for its pending 10/1 experiment. No same-molecule observed record was found, so the expected contrast is untested.","hypothesis_id":"H6"},{"id":"ca467c94f14b2219503e","reason":"At 10/1, this multifunctional ester is predicted at 25.7/47.8 mL, substantially later than its pending 5/1 prediction. The matched molecule and loading conditions isolate a potentially difficult solvent-ratio response; observed evidence is weak.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"8e7636d7a60a6058305a","reason":"The amino-substituted unsaturated ester has a high 20/1 prediction of 27.8/55.0 mL. Measuring it probes transfer to this polar structural motif at a PE-rich condition; the chemical rationale is a prior, not measured evidence.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"48679ae48dd485ffb7a6","reason":"Despite two ester groups and a 50/1 eluent, the prediction is relatively early at 11.6/16.5 mL. This tests whether the model handles the acetylenic diester's retention and V2−V1 width; direct evidence is weak.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"80f546c47198fa7c6dbf","reason":"This phenol is predicted at 20.8/47.3 mL at 50/1. Its hydrogen-bond donor and fluorinated ether test a chemical regime where V2 and the elution width could be difficult to generalize; this is an untested chemical prior.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"4da6e3b93f29af1efa94","reason":"The ortho-nitrobenzaldehyde prediction is 14.4/33.7 mL at 5/1. It adds a positional and functional-group probe alongside pending para-nitro carbonyl compounds, though differing conditions make that comparison weak.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"183af335033005f96b97","reason":"The aminoacetophenone prediction is 12.1/26.4 mL with a 900 µL DCM loading-solvent volume. This probes transfer to an amine-containing molecule and a relatively large loading volume; there is no controlled contrast here, so the evidence is weak.","hypothesis_id":null}],"hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","content":"Diethyl malonate may show a large increase in V1 and V2 between 10/1 and 20/1 PE/EA, as predicted. General chemical prior favors stronger retention under PE-rich conditions. The observed phenyl-substituted malonate rises from 12.2/18.9 mL at 10/1 to 21.0/32.5 mL at 20/1, but that is a different molecule and loading amount.","supporting_observed_ids":["9603a9567c8b21458d1e","2635b25bb3c1c37f3b74"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Does matched-loading diethyl malonate actually approach the predicted 30.7/49.3 mL at 20/1?"},{"id":"H2","content":"Fluorobenzoate V2 may have a local maximum near 5/1: predictions are 16.8 mL at 5/1 and 16.0 mL at 10/1. Measurements show an overall increase from 9.0 mL at 1/1 to 10.1 mL at 2/1 and 22.3 mL at 50/1, but do not resolve the proposed local reversal.","supporting_observed_ids":[],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"At identical 100 µL loading, is measured V2 at 5/1 greater than at 10/1?"},{"id":"H3","content":"Methyl benzoylformate V2 may flatten as PE/EA becomes more PE-rich. At 150 µL loading, observed V2 is 27.7 mL at 5/1 and 29.5 mL at 10/1; predictions at 20/1 and 50/1 remain near 29 mL. Persistence beyond 10/1 is untested.","supporting_observed_ids":["6c1c34b12c66ebcf39a4","ad0ace61c29817c678c2"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Do measured V1 and V2 remain nearly flat between 20/1 and 50/1 under matched loading?"},{"id":"H4","content":"Anthranilate may become substantially later and wider as the eluent changes from 5/1 to 20/1. The two 5/1 measurements at 50 and 150 µL are close, but there is no observed higher-ratio response; the steep rise comes from model predictions.","supporting_observed_ids":["3aed7873d2fd1cf48684","18186b5d6cc190fc07a3"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"At matched 100 µL loading, how much do measured V1 and V2 increase from 10/1 to 20/1?"},{"id":"H5","content":"Cyanobenzophenone may shift sharply from its observed early elution at 0/1 to much later, wider elution at 5/1 and beyond. This is a chemically plausible solvent-strength effect, but its magnitude is only predicted.","supporting_observed_ids":["6c27c0ab37bb8d812822"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Does the 5/1 measurement approach the predicted 12.1/33.7 mL and bridge the pending higher-ratio predictions?"},{"id":"H6","content":"Nitroacetophenone may move from early elution at 0/1 toward the much later pending 10/1 prediction. This follows a general solvent-strength prior; no same-molecule measured record was found.","supporting_observed_ids":[],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"What V1 and V2 are measured at 0/1, and how large is the eventual contrast with 10/1?"}],"feedback_interpretation":""}

{"type":"selection","packet_sha256":"78954e472e8384083a94a34ad731a44e4f13add6c6a7baacac9ae3d9265ad78b","choices":[{"id":"58b3518f48d8340d6ffc","reason":"Diethyl malonate measured only 4.6–5.9/6.3–7.9 mL at 10/1, 20/1 and 50/1, far earlier than its prior predictions. This 5/1 point tests whether the revised 7.6/12.6 mL prediction captures the low-ratio edge of that blind spot.","hypothesis_id":"H1"},{"id":"a17bcdddcf0799baeee2","reason":"Cyanobenzophenone rose from measured 5.1/21.3 mL at 5/1 to 19.7/55.7 mL at 20/1. The 50/1 prediction is 37.7/90.5 mL; measuring it tests the high-ratio continuation after earlier 5/1 and 10/1 predictions were too late.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"0f06772820e6693753e3","reason":"This phenylpyridine is predicted at 36.3/70.0 mL at 50/1. Two acquired ring-nitrogen compounds eluted substantially later than predicted, so this tests whether that generalization problem extends to a different heteroaromatic scaffold.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"e47aebe2660b9e1528de","reason":"Quinoline measured 27.9/57.7 mL at 5/1 versus a prior prediction of 19.6/41.8 mL. The 10/1 prediction of 28.3/62.8 mL tests whether the model now captures its solvent-ratio response; the pending methylquinoline is a related but distinct molecule.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"74c8fcd8ac3f6caedcd2","reason":"Dimethylpyridine measured 43.5/118.6 mL at 20/1, far above its prior prediction. This 5/1 prediction of 26.4/63.7 mL starts a matched-condition pair to locate where the strong retention develops.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"6f548d72f01fc85debdc","reason":"At matched 150 µL loading, the 10/1 dimethylpyridine prediction is 34.5/92.2 mL. Together with 5/1 and the measured 20/1 point, it tests the shape of a large V2 and elution-width response.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"a2f83665cfe821271b30","reason":"The amino-substituted unsaturated ester measured 47.0/119.4 mL at 20/1, greatly exceeding its prior prediction. A 10/1 measurement probes the lower-ratio response, though its DCM loading conditions differ from the measured PE-loaded point.","hypothesis_id":"H8"},{"id":"2dbfdf9c2d5defd09f7a","reason":"For this multifunctional ester, measured V2 rose from 43.9 mL at 5/1 to 94.2 mL at 10/1 and was underpredicted at both. The 2/1 prediction of 9.6/21.3 mL tests where the sharp change begins.","hypothesis_id":"H8"},{"id":"b4e0e9dc92fca2c88b90","reason":"The 5/1 aminobenzonitrile prediction is 19.7/45.7 mL. An acquired aminoacetophenone was later than predicted, but the structures and conditions differ; this is a weak test of transfer to another amine-bearing aromatic molecule.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"3fa513c053678904d89c","reason":"The phenolic aldehyde measured 22.9/57.5 mL at 50/1 and was predicted fairly closely. Its 0/1 prediction of 4.4/20.2 mL tests whether V2 remains broad under strong eluent, without assuming the errors seen for other phenols apply here.","hypothesis_id":"H9"},{"id":"8e99350aac88fae9186b","reason":"A related bromohydroxybenzaldehyde was earlier than predicted at 20/1. This 0/1 candidate probes the strong-eluent endpoint, but bromine position and loading volume also differ, so the comparison is weak.","hypothesis_id":"H9"},{"id":"0ae541927703401945de","reason":"The 2/1 trimethoxybenzene prediction is 12.7/25.8 mL. Paired with the pending 5/1 experiment on the same molecule, it tests whether the model transfers the solvent-ratio effect to a methoxy-rich aromatic; direct measured evidence is absent.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"4c3dce39521dcb1793a1","reason":"This 20/1 o-tolunitrile prediction of 16.5/26.8 mL bridges to its pending 50/1 experiment. Cyanobenzophenone was overpredicted at 5/1 and 10/1, but that different scaffold provides only weak evidence for a nitrile-wide issue.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"54f20e9bd23ee1c7b5db","reason":"The 1/1 cyclopropyl β-ketoester prediction is 4.1/8.4 mL. It supplies a strong-eluent anchor for the pending 20/1 experiment on the same molecule and tests whether the large predicted ratio contrast is real.","hypothesis_id":"H10"},{"id":"8925249b7fbe141dbce6","reason":"This bromomethyl benzoate measured 5.4/11.5 mL at 1/1 and 7.0/16.5 mL at 5/1. The 50/1 prediction of 20.2/36.7 mL tests extrapolation of its observed rising response to a PE-rich condition.","hypothesis_id":"H11"},{"id":"425fe9dfe0c3f345460b","reason":"The benzyl-substituted β-ketoester is predicted at 23.8/42.1 mL at 20/1. Measurements on a simpler β-ketoester cover only 2/1 and 5/1, so this weak chemical-transfer probe tests the effect of substitution at high PE.","hypothesis_id":"H10"}],"hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","content":"The earlier prediction that diethyl malonate becomes much later from 10/1 to 20/1 is contradicted: measured V1/V2 are 5.9/7.5 mL at 10/1, 4.6/6.3 mL at 20/1 and 5.8/7.9 mL at 50/1. These are far earlier than premeasurement predictions; behavior of phenyl-substituted malonate does not transfer directly.","supporting_observed_ids":["9603a9567c8b21458d1e","2635b25bb3c1c37f3b74"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["ab66de7edad40236ffd5","d7b0845793265cab0c33","f7d57d8bb988f7016502"],"evidence_strength":"strong","next_discriminating_question":"Does the 5/1 measurement also remain early, or is there a change below 10/1?"},{"id":"H2","content":"The proposed local fluorobenzoate V2 reversal was observed at matched 100 µL loading: V2 is 12.71 mL at 5/1 and 12.31 mL at 10/1. The 0.40 mL difference is small, so the shape should not be generalized confidently; V1 increased over the same contrast.","supporting_observed_ids":["33123966b214578291a5","09f7ce5c473ea7ea5d94"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Does the small V2 reversal persist across another loading amount or replicate?"},{"id":"H3","content":"The earlier high-ratio plateau hypothesis for methyl benzoylformate is contradicted. V2 measured 33.3 mL at 20/1 and 62.0 mL at 50/1, while premeasurement predictions stayed near 29 mL; the high-ratio elution width was substantially underpredicted.","supporting_observed_ids":["6c1c34b12c66ebcf39a4","ad0ace61c29817c678c2"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["bbb514661c0a49694d6a","7b42519983cf93dd7efd"],"evidence_strength":"strong","next_discriminating_question":"Where between 20/1 and 50/1 does the large rise in V2 occur?"},{"id":"H4","content":"The earlier anthranilate solvent-ratio-rise hypothesis is supported: measured V1/V2 progress from about 9/17 mL at 5/1 to 13.5/26.0 at 10/1, 19.9/38.2 at 20/1 and 34.0/75.2 at 50/1. The 10/1 prediction was close, while the 50/1 prediction underestimated both endpoints.","supporting_observed_ids":["3aed7873d2fd1cf48684","18186b5d6cc190fc07a3","693a65467095367c8e95","74541dbf8571f881c454","547923973b121019625f"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"strong","next_discriminating_question":"Does a related anthranilate show the same additional high-ratio rise?"},{"id":"H5","content":"Cyanobenzophenone shows a measured rise from 3.6/8.9 mL at 0/1 to 19.7/55.7 mL at 20/1, supporting a solvent-strength effect. Its premeasurement predictions were too late at 5/1 and 10/1, so the model misplaced part of the response curve; the 50/1 outcome remains unknown.","supporting_observed_ids":["6c27c0ab37bb8d812822","5ae7472a4d9ce3fe20d0","79ff49052bce33597828","59b54ad3a60a52cc2b2c"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Does measured V1/V2 at 50/1 approach the current 37.7/90.5 mL prediction?"},{"id":"H6","content":"Nitroacetophenone directly supports a large solvent-ratio response: measured V1/V2 change from 3.9/11.7 mL at 0/1 to 25.6/55.1 mL at 10/1. The 10/1 premeasurement V2 prediction of 66.8 mL was too late, so the magnitude remains a model issue.","supporting_observed_ids":["63962b52800b6ead5398","38e6b8bf0f089fcadd80"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"strong","next_discriminating_question":"At an intermediate ratio, does V2 rise smoothly or sharply?"},{"id":"H7","content":"Some aromatic ring-nitrogen compounds were later and wider than predicted: quinoline measured 27.9/57.7 mL at 5/1 and dimethylpyridine 43.5/118.6 mL at 20/1. This is not universal across nitrogen-containing molecules: ethyl nicotinate V2 was overpredicted at 2/1. Structural context and solvent ratio may matter.","supporting_observed_ids":["33ffc69a253a89f15995","51f4126a3aadb3239225"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["6a4e95d2a3cca31094a1"],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Do matched ratio series on quinoline and dimethylpyridine preserve the underpredicted late elution, and does phenylpyridine behave similarly?"},{"id":"H8","content":"At PE-rich conditions, V2 was substantially underpredicted for the measured multifunctional ester at 5/1 and 10/1 and for the amino-substituted unsaturated ester at 20/1. A shared mechanism is unproven; the observations justify probing lower ratios on each molecule.","supporting_observed_ids":["5d530b2f228ed39ff952","ca467c94f14b2219503e","8e7636d7a60a6058305a"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"At 2/1 for the multifunctional ester and 10/1 for the amino ester, where does measured V2 begin to diverge from predictions?"},{"id":"H9","content":"Two PE-rich phenols had large V2 underpredictions: trifluoromethoxyphenol measured 85.6 versus predicted 47.3 mL, and iodophenol measured 97.9 versus predicted 48.5 mL. The phenolic aldehyde at 50/1 was predicted closely, so this is a subset-specific observation rather than a general phenol rule.","supporting_observed_ids":["80f546c47198fa7c6dbf","95d1d257dfea69f178f8"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["fe1a34b5975943e8f292"],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"How do phenolic aldehydes behave under strong eluent, and do their widths remain large?"},{"id":"H10","content":"β-Ketoester structure and solvent ratio may jointly affect elution. The simple ethyl acetoacetate measurements give 9.0/20.2 mL at 2/1 and 11.4/25.3 mL at 5/1, but they cannot establish the response of cyclopropyl or benzyl-substituted variants at the selected conditions.","supporting_observed_ids":["6b38c8782f95c673c809","3ad8ec5752f3c638e2ff"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"How do the cyclopropyl compound's 1/1 and pending 20/1 outcomes compare, and is the benzyl-substituted 20/1 result distinct?"},{"id":"H11","content":"Bromomethyl benzoate V1/V2 increase from measured 5.4/11.5 mL at 1/1 to 7.0/16.5 mL at 5/1. Extrapolation to 50/1 is an untested model inference; the two observed points establish only the low-ratio direction.","supporting_observed_ids":["902f3082ba7241022d82","01472a37121478cb82be"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"At 50/1, does measured V1/V2 approach the predicted 20.2/36.7 mL?"}],"feedback_interpretation":"The revealed batch redirected this search toward specific failures: diethyl malonate stayed early despite very late predictions; methyl benzoylformate, multifunctional esters, selected phenols and ring-nitrogen compounds showed large V2 errors; cyanobenzophenone's predicted ratio curve was too late at 5/1 and 10/1. I chose lower-ratio anchors, matched-condition bridges and one higher-ratio extrapolation for those patterns. Anthranilate's 10/1 and 20/1 results were comparatively well predicted, so I did not spend another choice on it."}

{"type":"selection","packet_sha256":"9c3186390307c94bb9de365a691cd7adf3ee8b8c1f4eb388c4a9fab2d4189908","choices":[{"id":"2feb7d8e0a3566ddf97f","reason":"Aminobenzonitrile measured 40.6/98.4 mL at 5/1, far above its prior prediction. The 2/1 prediction is 17.8/39.0 mL; this locates where the steep response begins under matched loading conditions.","hypothesis_id":"H13"},{"id":"fd5fa962575144327bf4","reason":"The 0/1 aminobenzonitrile prediction is 4.4/12.0 mL. Together with the 2/1 choice and measured 5/1 result, it tests whether the large prior error persists under strong eluent.","hypothesis_id":"H13"},{"id":"810b065b0b86ff8c9aae","reason":"Phenylpyridine measured 46.4/103.3 mL at 50/1, substantially later than predicted. This 10/1 point uses the same 150 µL loading and tests the lower-ratio part of that possible model blind spot.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"434e465cfa7e0034f233","reason":"The 20/1 phenylpyridine prediction is 25.5/47.0 mL. It adds an intermediate ratio before the measured 50/1 endpoint; loading differs, so the ratio comparison has that limitation.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"04a2e8ad27ca641a3a12","reason":"Methylquinoline measured 51.3/108.5 mL at 10/1 versus a prior prediction of 24.2/55.1 mL. The 5/1 prediction of 34.4/66.6 mL tests whether the error extends to a stronger eluent.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"a38fee52661fd3e3b7ea","reason":"The oxime measured V2 of 119.2 mL at 50/1, 36.3 mL above its prior prediction. Measuring the 20/1 prediction of 35.5/85.8 mL tests where its large elution interval develops.","hypothesis_id":"H15"},{"id":"8a00e449393f9942971d","reason":"Methoxybenzophenone was later than predicted at both 20/1 and 50/1, unlike several methoxy aromatics that were earlier than predicted. Its 5/1 result tests where this molecule's error changes with eluent strength.","hypothesis_id":"H12"},{"id":"ce39d1762993bbbafaca","reason":"Trimethoxybenzene was earlier than predicted at 2/1 and 5/1. The 50/1 prediction is 13.3/22.4 mL; measuring it tests whether this error persists into a PE-rich regime.","hypothesis_id":"H12"},{"id":"a1809a6c4c3ada20bcb0","reason":"Cyclopropyl β-ketoester measured 6.3/11.9 mL at 1/1 and 44.5/81.2 mL at 20/1, the latter far above its prior prediction. This 5/1 point helps locate the rise alongside the pending 10/1 result.","hypothesis_id":"H10"},{"id":"327064e6ca2c38d79d76","reason":"The tert-butyl β-ketoester measured only 11.4/24.2 mL at 10/1 versus 23.2/46.9 mL predicted. Its 20/1 prediction of 23.1/48.0 mL tests whether that opposite-signed error persists at higher PE.","hypothesis_id":"H10"},{"id":"471287eecf7b94603e9e","reason":"Iodobenzoate measured an unusually early V1 of 5.1 mL but V2 of 29.3 mL at 50/1 and 150 µL. This 50 µL experiment tests loading dependence of that wide interval; the current prediction is 12.1/27.0 mL.","hypothesis_id":"H14"},{"id":"857ae40d0fdf1c7e387e","reason":"Ortho-nitrobenzaldehyde measured 6.9/23.0 mL at 5/1. The 20/1 prediction of 16.6/41.1 mL tests its solvent-ratio rise; a para isomer at 20/1 eluted much later, but different loading conditions limit that comparison.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"129036e0bccc4ff7e848","reason":"The brominated carboxylic acid has a 50/1 prediction of 29.9/67.7 mL. It probes a strongly interacting acid motif at high PE; no direct measured support is supplied, so this is an exploratory chemical-prior choice.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"b0f83f107759037eea65","reason":"Naphthylmethanol is predicted at 4.9/24.8 mL under 0/1 eluent. Its predicted elution width is large; comparison with pending benzyl alcohol measurements can test transfer across aromatic size, though the molecules differ.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"61764a2e9f71f1caa18e","reason":"Nitrobenzophenone at 1/1 and a 1000 µL loading-solvent volume is predicted at 7.9/20.7 mL. This tests a polar diaryl ketone under a large loading volume; direct same-molecule evidence is absent.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"3e41bb94c582476b5b6a","reason":"The oxime's 2/1 prediction is 9.1/19.3 mL. Paired with 20/1 and the measured 50/1 result, it distinguishes a gradual rise from a high-PE increase in V2 and elution width.","hypothesis_id":"H15"}],"hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","content":"The earlier steep-retention prediction for diethyl malonate is contradicted across measured 5/1, 10/1, 20/1 and 50/1 conditions: all V1 values are 4.1–5.9 mL and V2 values are 5.8–7.9 mL. Its phenyl-substituted analogue is much later under PE-rich eluent, so that analogue did not transfer.","supporting_observed_ids":["9603a9567c8b21458d1e","2635b25bb3c1c37f3b74"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["58b3518f48d8340d6ffc","ab66de7edad40236ffd5","d7b0845793265cab0c33","f7d57d8bb988f7016502"],"evidence_strength":"strong","next_discriminating_question":"What structural feature separates the early unsubstituted malonate from the retained phenyl-substituted analogue?"},{"id":"H2","content":"The small fluorobenzoate V2 reversal from 5/1 to 10/1 remains observed: 12.71 versus 12.31 mL at matched loading. Its 0.40 mL size leaves the broader curve shape uncertain.","supporting_observed_ids":["33123966b214578291a5","09f7ce5c473ea7ea5d94"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Would another loading amount reproduce this small local V2 difference?"},{"id":"H3","content":"The earlier methyl benzoylformate high-ratio plateau hypothesis remains contradicted: measured V2 rises from 33.3 mL at 20/1 to 62.0 mL at 50/1, while prior predictions stayed near 29 mL.","supporting_observed_ids":["6c1c34b12c66ebcf39a4","ad0ace61c29817c678c2"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["bbb514661c0a49694d6a","7b42519983cf93dd7efd"],"evidence_strength":"strong","next_discriminating_question":"At which intermediate PE/EA ratio does its high-ratio V2 rise accelerate?"},{"id":"H4","content":"Anthranilate's measured V1/V2 increase from about 9/17 mL at 5/1 to 34.0/75.2 mL at 50/1, supporting the earlier solvent-ratio hypothesis.
